missions.title: Departure Time I
missions.description: "The road home is only the beginning of another adventure."

missions.title: Departure Time II
missions.description: "Cherish every opportunity you have to choose, because there's no telling when you'll get one again."

missions.title: Departure Time III
missions.description: "Every bit of kindness comes at a price."

missions.title: Departure Time IV
missions.description: "I miss the man of yesterday and the city of tomorrow."

missions.title: The Curtain Rises I
missions.description: "New weapons, new battlefields."

missions.title: The Curtain Rises II
missions.description: "Rules are meant to be broken."

missions.title: Pollinosis I
missions.description: "A toast to yesterday's enemy."

missions.title: Pollinosis II
missions.description: "When you need to define the meaning of trust, you no longer need it."

missions.title: Pollinosis III
missions.description: "Don't you think you're acting like a girl who's throwing a sulking fit because she lost her favorite toy?"

missions.title: Pollinosis IV
missions.description: "When it comes to loyalty or otherwise, simply changing one's point of view will lead you to a different conclusion."

missions.title: Pollinosis V
missions.description: "You can't trust a single thing that comes out of a Sangvis Doll's mouth!"

missions.title: Pollinosis VI
missions.description: "Someday, we'll meet again. Someday."

missions.title: Ghost Sisters I
missions.description: "So, did you dream of me, or did I dream of you?"

missions.title: Ghost Sisters II
missions.description: "Besides, you won't remember in a couple of hours' time, so why should I tell you?"

missions.title: Ghost Sisters III
missions.description: "Rappel down the line into the warehouse, delay 404, and finish the encirclement."

missions.title: Ghost Sisters IV
missions.description: "I don't want to take that medicine anymore! I don't want to take the medicine! I want to get out... Let me out!"

missions.title: Ghost Sisters V
missions.description: "You're not allowed...to die first..."

missions.title: Ghost Sisters VI
missions.description: "No matter how well the place is scrubbed, there's no getting rid of the blood, filth and evil of the past."

missions.title: Hay Fever - Beginning
missions.description: "Hank, give me a pork knuckle burger!"

missions.title: Clown
missions.description: "What we can glean from flowers is hope."

missions.title: Flower View
missions.description: "Would an aphid munching on a flower think they're doing something wrong?"

missions.title: Gathering Frost Wolves
missions.description: "AN-94 does not have to make decisions very often, but when she has to, she makes very good ones."

missions.title: Light Show
missions.description: "Only humans can improve humanity."

missions.title: Hay Fever - End
missions.description: "Fate does not abandon people. Very often, it is people who abandon their fate on their own."

missions.title: Sweet Dreams Box - Beginning
missions.description: "Don't believe that dream-peddling luggage."

missions.title: Piper
missions.description: "See, the mice are all following him."

missions.title: Cuckoo Clock
missions.description: "A hand-made wooden box, ordered with triple-layer boards, very sturdy. About 1.5 meters long and 80cm or so across."

missions.title: Air Raid Shelter
missions.description: "A pair of dried skeletons dressed in orphanage clothing stare at her with empty eye sockets."

missions.title: Rag Doll
missions.description: "This is a letter from Housemother, telling me what a good girl Lilian is."

missions.title: Sweet Dreams Box - End
missions.description: "Because they save all the real good dreams for themselves."

missions.title: Operation Snake Eater I
missions.description: "...Because that was the fruit of Lyco's research. And I don't want his life's work falling into the hands of that bastard."

missions.title: Operation Snake Eater II
missions.description: "Ouroboros is a perfectionist."

missions.title: Operation Snake Eater III
missions.description: "Rather than being told what I am by others, I'd rather believe in my own thoughts."

missions.title: Operation Snake Eater IV
missions.description: "Don't play hide and seek with a snake."

missions.title: Operation Snake Eater V
missions.description: "I need to leave a little memento behind, because I might not have the chance to do it in future."

missions.title: Delta Attack - Beginning
missions.description: "If an agent is instantly recognizable as an agent, then he won't be in his position for long."

missions.title: Spiderweb
missions.description: "Welcome to the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen! We wish you a pleasant journey!"

missions.title: House of Cards
missions.description: "If you want to build a peaceful world, you must first fight a cruel war."

missions.title: Animal Chess
missions.description: "The more you rank people, the more ways they find to flaunt their superiority."

missions.title: Instigator
missions.description: "The real world doesn't change. It simply expresses itself in different ways, but it is fundamentally always the same."

missions.title: Delta Attack - End
missions.description: "There are two sides to everything. This is also true about people."

missions.title: Infernal Enlightenment I
missions.description: "I'm still alive, but I'll be dead soon."

missions.title: Infernal Enlightenment II
missions.description: "Hold nothing back. Failure is not an option."

missions.title: Infernal Enlightenment III
missions.description: "The cage is go, and the fleeing hare has run into it."

missions.title: Infernal Enlightenment IV
missions.description: "I want world peace. I want children to be spared living in strife and fear."

missions.title: Infernal Enlightenment V
missions.description: "It's been such a long day. I'm glad it's finally over..."

missions.title: Foreshadowed Voyage
missions.description: "Then I promise you, I won't lie to you ever again."

missions.title: Bridge of Eternity
missions.description: "Perhaps you'll miss me and come to treasure the time we've spent together. But don't worry, we'll meet again very soon."
